title: netreceive
description: listen for incoming messages from network

messages.description: messages sent from connected netsend objects
address and port (only with the -f flag)

flags.name: -f
flags.description: flag for from address & port outlet

methods.description: a number sets or changes the port number (0 or negative closes the port). Optional symbol is a hostname which can be a UDP multicast address or a network interface
sends messages back to connected netsend objects

body: [netreceive] listens on a network port for messages from [netsend] objects or other software, over TCP by default or UDP with -u, and outputs them. With TCP, the middle outlet reports the number of open connections, and 'send' sends messages back to them. With -b, messages are received as lists of bytes.
